title: Crispy Baked Chicken Wings
instructions: Adjust your oven racks to the upper-middle and lower-middle positions and preheat the oven to 425°F.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil, place a wire rack (a cooling rack works) on top, and spray the rack with nonstick spray.
Pat the wings very dry with paper towels — it's important to dry them REALLY well — and place them in a large bowl.
Combine the salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and baking powder in a small bowl, then sprinkle the seasonings over the wings and toss to coat evenly.
Arrange the wings skin side up in a single layer on the prepared wire rack.
Bake, turning every 20 minutes, until the wings are crispy and browned — total cook time may take up to 1 hour depending on the size of the wings.
Remove from the oven, let stand for 5 minutes, transfer the wings to a bowl, and toss with the Buffalo sauce.
For the Buffalo sauce: stir all the sauce ingredients together in a medium saucepan over medium heat and mix well until the sugar has dissolved.
Remove from the heat and let cool to room temperature before tossing with the wings (or make the sauce ahead of time and refrigerate).
notes: Original note: ¾ tsp salt (do ¼ tsp).
